reply_text:
I replied in the #coastal-team thread. I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 "Coastal week ahead" post, because I have no scheduler that runs on its own.

The reply offers two options:
- **Scheduled post:** set it up in whatever scheduling tool the team already uses, and I can supply the digest content when it fires.
- **On request:** ask me in the thread each Monday and I'll post the digest. The first would be Monday 19 Oct, drawing on #coastal-team and #coastal-random.

Either way, the digest will leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoice amounts), since those can't go into a channel without approval from Anselm or June. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers can stay in.
